# Jeremia Imanuel Werung

> Jeremia Imanuel Werung is a QA engineer and web developer based in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. He holds a Bachelor of Information Systems (S.Kom) from Universitas Teknologi Yogyakarta and works on manual and automated software testing (Playwright, PHPUnit) and Laravel web development.

This is his personal portfolio. It lists real projects running in production, QA case studies with test cases and bug reports, and a live dashboard of his GitHub and coding activity.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jeremiawerung.my.id/): overview, featured work, and skills
- [About](https://jeremiawerung.my.id/about): background, work experience, and education
- [Projects](https://jeremiawerung.my.id/projects): RFID school attendance system, Aurora Beauty Salon reservation system, Cetak Foto Jogja business platform, Gracia Photo company profile, Estimator.id, RTHP System (DLH Yogyakarta)
- [Case Studies](https://jeremiawerung.my.id/case-studies): QA work from requirements to test cases, bug reports, and Playwright automation
- [Achievements](https://jeremiawerung.my.id/achievements): certifications and licenses
- [Insights](https://jeremiawerung.my.id/insights): articles on software testing and quality engineering
- [Dashboard](https://jeremiawerung.my.id/dashboard): live GitHub contributions, coding activity, and site traffic
- [Contact](https://jeremiawerung.my.id/contact): email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and Instagram
